第一卷 第23章 深藏不露众人忌惮（第1页）
围观的外门弟子陆续散去，林间风声再起，冲淡了方才交手残留的灵力余波。
只是所有人心中的看法，已然悄然颠覆。
在此之前，整个外门几乎所有人都默认一个定论：苏玄尘空有千年难遇的极品天灵根，奈何年岁太高、肉身枯朽、寿元微薄，纵使天赋再逆天，也终究是昙花一现，难堪大用。
可方才那一幕，彻底打碎了众人的固有认知。
仅有炼气三层修为的百岁老者，硬生生扛住了外门第一天才林辰的炼气九层威压，甚至在招式对拼当中不落下风。
这份战力，早已超脱了低层修士的常理范畴。
“没想到苏师兄居然这么能扛，那可是九层巅峰的压迫！”
“灵力纯度差距太大了，天灵根果然不是普通上品灵根能比的。”
“以前只觉得他可怜，空有天赋没寿命，现在看来，是我们看走眼了。”
“连林辰都压不住他，低层里面谁还敢惹这位老人？”
细碎的议论声在林间此起彼伏，随风飘散。
不少原本心里打着算盘、想在秘境中趁机欺凌老者、抢夺资源的弟子，此刻彻底熄灭了心中贪念。
能正面硬撼林辰的存在，绝不是软柿子。
人群散开之后，聚灵泉依旧被林辰和他的一众追随者牢牢把持。
作为外门底蕴最深厚的天才，林辰无论是心境、阅历、修为，都稳压同阶弟子一头，手握秘境核心最优质的聚灵宝地，无人再敢上前争锋。
苏玄尘目光淡淡扫过泉眼方向，没有半分留恋。
聚灵泉虽好，却太过招眼，是人是非地。
数百双眼睛盯着，天骄云集，争端不断，贸然争抢只会将自己推到风口浪尖。
他寿元本就岌岌可危，修行只求稳字当头，从不爱慕虚名、不争一时锋芒。
与其在众人眼皮底下争热闹机缘，不如深入无人险地，独享隐秘造化，默默积累底蕴。
这是他百年人生沉淀下来的沉稳心性，也是凡人流修士最稳妥的生存之道。
整理心绪，苏玄尘收敛全身气息，将修为牢牢压在三层初阶的平淡表象，迈步朝着秘境更深处走去。
越往秘境腹地深入，周遭环境愈发幽暗凶险。
参天古木遮天蔽日，层层叠叠的枝叶几乎隔绝了天光，林间湿气浓重，地面腐叶堆积数寸之厚，落脚无声，极易隐匿杀机。
空气中不断传来远处妖兽的低沉嘶吼，此起彼伏，透着蛮荒凶戾之气。
寻常外门弟子，大多止步于此，不敢再深入半步。
秘境中层往后，妖兽实力暴涨，最低都是炼气五层水准，更有高阶妖兽潜伏暗处，偷袭致命。
且深处极少有弟子结伴同行，一旦遭遇险情，无人救援，十死无生。
也正因绝大多数弟子畏险不前，这片区域的灵材灵药，极少被人搜刮，留存无数零碎机缘。
他五感远超常人，极品天灵根不仅吸纳灵气速度恐怖，更能敏锐捕捉周遭数十丈内的风吹草动、生灵吐息。
行走密林之间，他不急不躁，目光细致扫过沿途每一寸土地。
这些在外门弟子眼中微不足道、懒得采摘的低级灵药，在他眼里皆是固本培元、滋养肉身的珍贵资源。
他修行时日太短、底蕴太薄、寿元太浅，没有资格挑肥拣瘦。
积微成著，点滴积累，方能步步前行。
一路缓步深入，半个时辰转瞬即逝。
周遭彻底听不到半点人声，整片密林彻底陷入寂静，只剩下风声簌簌、兽吼隐隐。
就在这时，一股浓郁阴冷的腥气，顺着风势扑面而来。
气息凶煞厚重，远超之前遇到的青纹妖狼。
苏玄尘脚步一顿，心神微凛，身躯悄然隐入一株千年古木后方，凝神探查前方动静。
他清楚知晓，真正的高阶秘境妖兽，出现了。

Volume 1 Chapter 23 Everyone is afraid of hiding something (Page 1)
The onlookers of the outer disciples dispersed one after another, and the sound of wind in the forest began again, diluting the remaining spiritual aftermath of the exchange just now.
It's just that everyone's opinions have been quietly subverted.
Before that, almost everyone in the outer sect had agreed upon one conclusion: Su Xuanchen had the best spiritual root that could only be found in a thousand years, but he was too old, his body was decayed, and his lifespan was meager. Even if his talent was heaven-defying, it would be short-lived and useless.
But that scene just now completely shattered everyone's inherent understanding.
A centenarian with only the third level of Qi Refining, he was able to withstand the pressure of the ninth level of Qi Refining, Lin Chen, the number one genius in the outer sect, and even managed to survive the duel of moves.
This combat power has long gone beyond the common sense of low-level monks.
"I didn't expect Senior Brother Su to be so able to withstand the pressure of the ninth level!"
"The difference in the purity of spiritual power is too big. The Heavenly Spiritual Root is indeed not comparable to ordinary high-grade spiritual roots."
"I used to think that he was pitiful because he only had talent but no longevity. Now it seems that we have made a mistake."
"Even Lin Chen can't suppress him. Who on the lower floors dares to mess with this old man?"
Tiny voices of discussion rippled through the forest, drifting in the wind.
Many disciples who had originally planned to take the opportunity to bully the old man and rob the resources in the secret realm completely extinguished their greed at this moment.
The person who can challenge Lin Chen head-on is by no means a soft persimmon.
After the crowd dispersed, Julingquan was still firmly controlled by Lin Chen and his followers.
As the genius with the deepest foundation in the outer sect, Lin Chen had a head start on the disciples of the same level in terms of his state of mind, experience, and cultivation. He held the best spiritual gathering treasure land at the core of the secret realm, and no one dared to step forward to compete.
Su Xuanchen's eyes glanced in the direction of the spring, without any nostalgia.
Although Julingquan is good, it is too eye-catching and is confusing to people and places.
Hundreds of pairs of eyes are staring at each other, geniuses gather, and disputes continue. Rushing to compete will only push oneself to the forefront.
His longevity was already in jeopardy, so he only sought to maintain his reputation as a leader in practice. He never cherished fame or competed for a moment's edge.
Instead of competing for exciting opportunities in front of everyone, it is better to go deep into uninhabited places, enjoy the secret fortune alone, and silently accumulate knowledge.
This is the calmness of his mind that has accumulated over a hundred years of life, and it is also the safest way for a mortal monk to survive.
After gathering his thoughts, Su Xuanchen gathered his aura, firmly suppressed his cultivation to the plain appearance of the third level, and walked deeper into the secret realm.
The deeper you go into the hinterland of the secret realm, the surrounding environment becomes darker and more dangerous.
Towering ancient trees block out the sky and the sun, and the layers of branches and leaves almost cut off the skylight. The humidity in the forest is thick, and the rotten leaves on the ground are piled up several inches thick. It is silent when you set foot, making it easy to hide murderous intentions.
The low roars of distant monsters kept coming from the air, one after another, exuding a wild and ferocious atmosphere.
Most of the ordinary outer sect disciples stop here and dare not go any further.
After the middle level of the secret realm, the strength of the monsters skyrockets, reaching as low as the fifth level of Qi Refining. There are also high-level monsters lurking in the dark, delivering deadly sneak attacks.
Moreover, there are very few disciples traveling together in the depths. Once in danger, no one will rescue them, and there will be no chance of death.
Precisely because the vast majority of disciples are afraid of danger, the spiritual materials and elixirs in this area are rarely searched for, leaving countless fragmentary opportunities.
His five senses are far beyond those of ordinary people. The top-quality Tianling Root not only absorbs spiritual energy at a terrifying speed, but can also keenly capture the movement and breath of living creatures within dozens of feet around him.
Walking in the dense forest, he was not impatient and his eyes carefully scanned every inch of land along the way.
These low-level elixirs, which in the eyes of the outer disciples were insignificant and too lazy to pick, were in his eyes precious resources that strengthened the body and nourished the body.
His cultivation time is too short, his foundation is too weak, and his longevity is too short, so he is not qualified to be picky.
Only by accumulating little things can we move forward step by step.
Walking slowly and deeply all the way, half an hour passed in a blink of an eye.
There was no human sound at all around, and the entire dense forest fell into complete silence, leaving only the rustling of the wind and the faint roar of animals.
At this moment, a strong and cold fishy smell blew towards his face along with the wind.
The aura was fierce and thick, far more powerful than the blue-patterned demon wolf I had encountered before.
Su Xuanchen paused in his steps, his mind a little trembling, and his body quietly disappeared behind a thousand-year-old tree, and he concentrated on exploring the movement ahead.
He knew clearly that a real high-level secret realm monster had appeared.
